technical.summary: Strong structural bullish alignment with golden cross and Ichimoku confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 83, Stoch 88) and declining volume momentum create elevated pullback risk for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IRM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 50 days.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; fear sentiment (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of insider buying conviction and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.48), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent CPI event, and negative macro score (-6) create severely adverse conditions; 50-day earnings window adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (SMA 50/200) and Ichimoku tk-cross provide structural bullish alignment with price above all major moving averages, offering a technically sound directional setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 83, Stoch 88), collapsing volume momentum (ratio 0.68), zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level VIX (432.48), and unfavorable macro environment (-6 score) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is sound with golden cross and Ichimoku confirmation, but entry timing is severely compromised by extreme overbought conditions (RSI 83, Stoch 88) and collapsing volume momentum at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (432.48), unfavorable macro environment, and earnings event within 50 days create unacceptable execution risk; overbought pullback likely before swing target is reached.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case despite technical bullish setup
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding IRM position with 21 existing Real Estate exposures (15% of portfolio); concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding to position.
